subject: MAP: data-handling milestone — evidence & owners
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Tobin <alex.tobin@medisync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: data-handling milestone — initial recap

Alex — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap of the data-handling milestone we agreed to include in the MAP and the immediate asks so we keep the procurement/technical review moving: 

Milestone: Data-handling acceptance (retention, logging, audit trails, PHI/PII constraints)
- Target close: 2027-05-15 (customer target)
- Redwood deliverables: SOC2 summary + audit log retention options, configurable retention policy doc, sample ingestion/logging retention config
- Customer asks: confirmation of PHI processing model, data-in-transit and at-rest encryption details, evidence for audit (attestation / sample logs)
- Dependencies: SOC2 attestation file (we provided 2026 summary), legal review on DPA redlines, procurement timeline

Immediate next steps (action owners and deadlines):
1) Kimberly (AE) — upload MAP draft with proposed milestone wording and deliverables (today EOD) — attach to HubSpot
2) Marissa (CS) — prepare short runbook for log access & sample retention config for their security team (by 2027-04-08)
3) Rishi (Solutions) — confirm quantization/processing note for PHI inference path and whether we can provide a PHI isolation topology diagram (by 2027-04-07)

Can you confirm: 1) target close date above, 2) who from Medisync will own internal acceptance (security, legal, procurement), and 3) whether you prefer evidence delivered as a Drive bundle or a signed DocuSign attestation?

Attachments: none yet — will push MAP draft in follow-up.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(Attachment stub: MAP-outline-keys.txt)

From: Alex Tobin <alex.tobin@medisync.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medisync.com>, procurement@medisync.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: data-handling milestone — initial recap

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side: 
- Target close: our internal target is 2027-05-20 to allow a two-week procurement window after legal signs off. 2027-05-15 is tight but possible if legal moves quickly.
- Owners: Security: Samantha Lee (cc'd). Legal: procurement@medisync.com (they coordinate redlines). Procurement lead: Angela Park (procurement@medisync.com).
- Evidence preference: Drive bundle first for internal review; if legal asks for signatures we'll take a DocuSign attestation.

Questions: 
1) For PHI, will Redwood support a dedicated VPC/private deployment option or do you expect our footprint to be on shared hosted? We discussed both but need explicit statement for our RFP.
2) Can you confirm what retention windows you support out-of-the-box (30/90/365 days) and whether we can self-configure longer windows for audit purposes?

Appreciate the MAP draft when you have it.

—Alex
Alex Tobin
Director, IT Security & Compliance
Medisync Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Tobin <alex.tobin@medisync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@medisync.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: data-handling milestone — initial recap

Thanks Alex — uploading the MAP draft and two supporting artifacts to Drive now. Key points answering your questions below (pulled from the draft):

1) PHI deployment model: Redwood supports two paths for PHI production workloads:
   - Private deployment (VPC or on-prem): full isolation, customer-managed network, recommended for PHI workloads (we can include HSM/KMS integration notes).
   - Hosted with tenant isolation: shared runtime but strict logical separation; recommended only for non-PHI or de-identified data.
   Statement we added to MAP: "Medisync to confirm preferred deployment mode (Private VPC recommended for PHI). Redwood will provide evidence of encryption at rest/in transit and architecture diagram for chosen topology."

2) Retention windows: default policy templates are 30 / 90 / 365 days. We can provision custom retention (longer) for Dedicated or Private deployments; these are configurable and can be enumerated in the MAP as options with cost delta.

3) Audit evidence: attached SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (summary + control mapping) and a sample audit log bundle are in Drive. If legal requires a signed attestation we will provide a DocuSign-ready statement.

MAP excerpt (milestone wording we uploaded):
"Milestone: Data-handling acceptance — Redwood to provide SOC2 summary, sample audit logs, configurable retention profile, PHI deployment statement, and topology diagram. Customer to confirm deployment choice and acceptance criteria. Acceptance leads: Medisync Security (Samantha Lee). Target acceptance date: 2027-05-15 (subject to legal/procurement)."

Attachments (pushed to Drive): MAP-draft-v1.pdf, SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, sample-audit-logs-anon.zip (link in Drive). HubSpot note updated: deal HS-4527.

Next asks: Samantha (cc) — please confirm acceptance criteria you want on sample logs (fields, retention slices), and procurement@medisync.com — please confirm timeline for legal review so we can align dates.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLink (contains MAP + evidence)

Thanks — I will also attach a short runbook for log extraction for your SecOps team (Marissa will prepare a 1-pager).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Tobin <alex.tobin@medisync.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: data-handling milestone — initial recap

Alex/Samantha — quick note from CS: I will produce the log access runbook and a sample retention config by 2027-04-08. Items I'll include:
- Example API calls and RBAC for log access
- Sample retention policy YAML (30/90/365 + custom example)
- Instructions to request export for audits (format, fields, anonymization options)

If Samantha can list the fields they want in sample logs (e.g., request_id, timestamp, model_id, input_hash, redaction_flag) that will speed the deliverable.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Tobin <alex.tobin@medisync.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@medisync.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: data-handling milestone — initial recap

Thanks, Kimberly & Marissa — that flow looks good. A few confirmations: 
- Medisync confirms target acceptance date: we will aim for 2027-05-18 to give legal a few extra days.
- Owner confirmations: Security lead: Samantha Lee (will reply separately with fields); Procurement lead: Angela Park (procurement@medisync.com) - they expect to start redline review week of 2027-04-12.
- Evidence: Drive bundle preferred; will request DocuSign only if legal requires it.

Samantha — please reply with required sample-log fields. Angela/procurement — FYI on expected timeline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the MAP draft. Once we get Samantha's list I'll mark the milestone as "Ready for technical acceptance" in the MAP.

—Alex
